title: lucille-host --json: credential
description: A credential kept on this computer: its service, its name, the hosts it may be sent to, and when it was saved. Never its value.

hosts.description: The hosts it may be sent to, in the order given when it was saved; empty for one saved without hosts.

name.description: A service's or a credential's name: 1 to 64 characters of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or a digit.

host.description: A host a credential may be sent to: a DNS name of two labels or more, lowercase ASCII, no port, no IP address.

time.description: A time, UTC, ISO 8601, to the second.
